gear_calendar_id.description: Google Calendar ID of gear requests calendar

gear_calendar_url.description: The public URL to the gear calendar to share with bands

timezone.description: Name of time zone gear closet is in

calendar_refresh_mins.description: Number of minutes between refreshes of gear request calendar

admin_role.description: Role to grant access of commands to

quartermaster_channel.description: Channel to remind the quartermaster to change the lockbox code in

quartermaster_role.description: Role of quartermaster role to mention in reminders to change the lockbox code

change_code_reminder_time.description: Time (in ISO format) to send reminder to change lockbox code

change_code_re-reminder_hours.description: Number of hours after initial reminder to re-remind quartermaster to change lockbox code if not done so (set to `0` to disable)

min_change_code_days.description: Minimum number of days between code change reminders

weekend_change_code_reminder_mode.description: Manner to set codes to expire on weekends. One of `0`: Only weekdays, `1`: Include Saturdays, `2`: Include Sundays, `3`: All days of the week

quartermaster_reminder_time_mins.description: Number of minutes before setup time to inform the quartermaster of requests not associated with a band

quartermaster_request_range_mins.description: Range of minutes after scheduled request not associated with a band to search for events to add to the quartermaster reminder message

setup_time_mins.description: Number of minutes before a band's rehearsal to send the lockbox code

picture_before_reminder_mode.description: Manner to send reminders to send picture of closet before rehearsal. One of `0`: Never, `1`: Only if start of rehearsal is not overlapping or adjacent, `2`: Always

picture_before_reminder_mins.description: Number of minutes into a band's rehearsal to send reminder to send picture of closet (if setting enabled and image not already sent)

picture_after_reminder_mode.description: Manner to send reminders to send picture of closet after rehearsal. One of, `0`: Never, `1`: Only if end of rehearsal is not overlapping or adjacent, `2`: Always

teardown_time_mins.description: Number of minutes after a band's rehearsal to send reminder to send picture of closet (if setting enabled and image not already sent)
